Help More Labeling and identifying AI content is different for ads.
As more generative AI tools become available, it’s important to be able to recognize when something may have been created or modified with generative AI.
Why label your AI-generated content on Instagram # Labeling your AI-generated or AI-modified content on Instagram helps establish transparency and trust.
In some cases it’s required.
Learn more about this requirement in the Transparency Center .
Content may be labeled automatically when it contains AI signals, or you can label AI-generated or AI-modified content when you share it on Instagram.
How AI content is identified on Instagram # There are many AI tools that can create or modify content.
Some content that is made or modified using one of these tools may have an industry-standard signal that identifies the content as being created or modified using AI tools.
For example, you might create an image collage using a common photo editing tool to share with your followers.
Photo editing tools that use AI to change the size or color of an image may add a signal showing that the content was modified using AI.
These signals are read by Meta’s systems to determine if the content needs a label.
When content will have a label #
When Meta AI tools are used .
Content that is created or modified using Meta’s AI tools and shared to Instagram directly as a post, story, or reel may automatically be labeled above or on the content.
For example, some content may have a visible watermark that says Imagined with AI .
When created content has AI signals .
Content with industry-standard signals indicating that it was created with AI will be labeled with AI info .
This includes content that is created using third-party AI tools.
Content that is created using Meta’s AI tools, downloaded to a device and then uploaded to Instagram will also receive an AI info label .
Content with industry-standard signals indicating that it was modified with AI will not receive an AI info label directly on the post, story, reel or thread.
Information about AI used to create or modify content can be found by clicking the Options menu on any post, story, reel or thread, regardless of the type of signal Meta receives.
This approach will evolve as people’s expectations and the technology evolve.
Note: Not all AI content contains the information needed to identify it.
When the AI info label is required # Meta requires you to label content you share that has photorealistic video or realistic-sounding audio that has been digitally generated or altered, including with AI.
This means that if a digital creation or AI tool was used to create or modify this kind of content, you must label the content before you share it.
Meta does not require you to label images that have been created or altered with AI.
Images will still receive a label if Meta’s systems detect they were AI-generated.
Note: There may be penalties if you do not label content as required.
Here are some examples of digitally created content that requires a label: A video that appears realistic of a group of people walking around an outdoor market An audio file of two people talking A song created using AI-generated vocals A reel narrated with a realistic AI-generated voiceover Here are some examples of digitally created content that does not require a label: Video of an outdoor landscape, created in a style resembling a cartoon Image of person riding a bull (Meta does not require you to label images)
You can read more about this requirement in the Transparency Center .
How to label your AI-generated content # When you label your content, people will see an AI info label on your post.
Note: If you choose not to identify AI use in the content you share, an AI info label will be applied if Meta detects that the content was AI-generated.
Label your AI content # Label AI-generated posts Create a post .
Tap Toggle next to Add AI label to label your content.
Label AI-generated Stories Share a photo or video to your Instagram story .
Tap Options in your story, then tap Label AI .
Tap Toggle next to Add AI label to label your content.
Label AI-generated Reels Create a reel .
Tap Toggle next to Add AI label to label your content.

Instagram Features Messaging Use AI generated stickers on Instagram Android App Help iPhone App Help More Android App Help
iPhone App Help This feature is being gradually introduced and may not be available to you yet.
When you send a sticker in a chat or add stickers to your Instagram story , you also have the option of using a custom AI sticker.
Your sticker is generated by artificial intelligence (AI) based on your text prompt you enter in the stickers’ search field.
Send an AI sticker in a chat #
Tap Messages in the top right of Feed.
Tap a username or group name to open the conversation.
You can also start a new conversation by tapping Compose in the top right.
Tap Stickers in the bottom right, then tap AI Stickers .
Enter a text prompt in the search field and tap Send .
For example, a text prompt can be as specific as, “astronaut riding a horse in space.”
Your AI stickers will appear above your search entry.
Tap an AI sticker to send it to your chat.
If you send an AI sticker, people in the chat will also see the text prompt you entered.
Learn how to send a generated image in a chat.
Add an AI sticker to a story # Before you share a photo or video to your story , tap Stickers at the top.
Tap AI STICKERS .
Enter a text prompt in English, then tap Generate .
Tap an AI sticker to add it to your story.
Keep in mind # Text prompts and uses of AI stickers must follow our Community Standards and Terms of Use .
AI stickers generated automatically in response to your text prompt may be inaccurate or inappropriate.
Be mindful before including any personal information in your text prompt (examples: name, address, email, or phone number).
Meta may collect and use information such as your text prompt and stickers to improve how our artificial intelligence models work.
Visit our Privacy Policy to learn more.
Learn more about how Meta uses information for generative AI models .

iPhone App Help You can write captions for your Instagram Stories using Meta AI.
To write a caption for your Instagram Story using Meta AI: After you select a photo or video to share to your story, tap .
Type any text you like, then tap .
Meta AI will generate a caption based off of your text.
Tap next to your text prompt to generate new caption choices.
Tap a tone at the bottom to generate captions.
Tap to give feedback on a result.
Tap on a caption to add it to your story.
Keep in mind # Text prompts and uses of AI images must follow our Community Standards and Terms of Use .
AI texts generated automatically in response to your text prompt may be inaccurate or inappropriate Be mindful before including any personal information in your text prompt (examples: name, address, email, or phone number).
Meta may use your feedback and messages to AI to improve AI quality.
Meta may share the messages you send to AI and general information, like your region, with our select partners so you can get better results.
Visit our Meta AI Terms of Service to learn more.

Generative AI Editing Disclosures | Instagram Help Center Help Center English (US) Instagram Features Manage Your Account Staying Safe Privacy, Security and Reporting Terms and Policies Threads Generative AI Editing Disclosures Generative AI editing features, like Backdrop, allow you to edit photos of yourself using visual effects powered by AI and share the edited photos on Instagram.
Users select the photo of themselves that they would like to edit from their photo roll.
They can then enter a prompt, such as a description of a new style of photo they want, and the feature will create a new version of the photo based on that prompt.
For example, users may be able to select a segment of the photo to retain and then enter a prompt to alter the background.
This disclosure applies to Meta Platforms, Inc.’s (“we,” “us,” or “our”) processing of your information in connection with providing the Generative AI editing features.
When you choose to edit a photo of yourself through a Generative AI editing feature, our AI technology may collect information about your face and facial features as they appear in the photo, including their location, orientation, and topology in the photo.
This information cannot be used to identify you.
This information will be used for the sole purpose of generating an edited photo and will be promptly deleted after the edited photo is generated.
By enabling Generative AI editing features, you agree to the use of Generative AI editing features, and to the collection and use of your information as described above.
You can always choose not to use these features and such information will not be collected and used.
You further represent, warrant, and agree that you will not use Generative AI editing features to edit any photos in which a person other than you appears.

iPhone App Help This feature currently isn’t available to everyone.
You can use Meta AI on Instagram to get advice or ask questions.
Use Meta AI on Instagram #
Tap an option below to learn how to access and use Meta AI on Instagram.
Start a conversation with Meta AI Use Meta AI in a chat with others Access Meta AI in search Keep in mind # Similar to other chats, conversations with AI are subject to our Community Standards and Terms of Service .
An AI’s response may be inaccurate or inappropriate and should not be used to make important decisions.
In end-to-end encrypted chats with other people, messages that mention @Meta AI and messages from Meta AI are not encrypted.
All other messages in the chat remain encrypted unless someone in the chat shares them with Meta to use an optional feature.
For certain features, Meta may use your feedback and messages shared with Meta AI to provide and improve AI at Meta.
Meta may share the messages you send to AI and general information, like your region, with select partners so you can get better results.
Visit our Meta AI Terms of Service to learn more.
Sometimes, an AI may use your location information to give you more relevant responses.
Your location information is based on things like the settings you've chosen on your device, or your activity across our products.
Learn more about how to manage your location in the Privacy Center .
Other information from your profile like your age and gender, and interests based on your activity across our products, such as the types of content, including ads, you view or interact with and how you interact with it, may be used to help personalize your interactions with AI.
This information may also be used to produce and improve AI at Meta.
Learn more about how Meta uses this information in the Privacy Center.
You can also see how information is used across your accounts in the same Accounts Center.
You can always download or access your information in settings.
Learn how to Download a copy of your information .

Our Agreement and What Happens if We Disagree # 7.1 Our Agreement.
Your use of music on the Service is also subject to our Music Guidelines , and your use of our API is subject to our Meta Platform Terms and Developer Policies .

For example, if you use payment features, you will be asked to agree to the Community Payment Terms .
If you use Avatars, then the Avatar Terms also apply.
If you use our AI products and features, the Meta AI Terms also apply.
If any of those terms conflict with this agreement, those other terms will govern.
